pairs: and the earth is my footstool.
Quæ est ista domus quam ædificabitis mihi?
What is this house that you would build for me?
et quis est iste locus quietis meæ?
And what is this place of my rest?
My hand has made all these things,
and all these things have been made,
But upon whom will I look with favor,
except upon a poor little one,
and who trembles at my words?
it is as if he slaughters a man.
it is as if he is smashing the head of a dog.
quasi qui sanguinem suillum offerat; qui recordatur thuris,
it is as if he is offering swine’s blood. Whoever makes remembrance with incense,
it is as if he is blessing an idol.
Hæc omnia elegerunt in viis suis,
All these things, they have chosen according to their own ways,
et in abominationibus suis anima eorum delectata est.
and their soul has taken delight in their own abominations.
Unde et ego eligam illusiones eorum,
Therefore, I also will choose their illusions,
et quæ timebant adducam eis; quia vocavi,
and I will lead over them the things that they feared. For I called,
and there was no one who would respond.
And they have done evil in my eyes;
and what I did not will, they have chosen.
Listen to the word of the Lord,
you who tremble at his word. Your brothers,
Dixerunt fratres vestri odientes vos, et abjicientes propter nomen meum:
who hate you and who cast you out because of my name, have said:
and we will see by your rejoicing.”
But they themselves will be confounded.
A voice of the people from the city!
vox Domini reddentis retributionem inimicis suis.
The voice of the Lord repaying retribution to his enemies!
Before her time arrived for delivery,
she gave birth to a male child.
Who has ever heard of such a thing?
And who has seen anything like this?
numquid parturiet terra in die una,
Will the earth give birth in one day?
Or will a nation be born all at once?
For Zion has been in labor,
and she has given birth to her sons.
Numquid ego qui alios parere facio,
Will I, who causes others to give birth,
all you who mourn over her!
So may you nurse and be filled,
et repleamini ab ubere consolationis ejus;
from the breasts of her consolations.
So may you receive milk and overflow with delights,
et deliciis affluatis ab omnimoda gloria ejus.
from every portion of her glory.
For thus says the Lord: Behold,
Ecce ego declinabo super eam quasi fluvium pacis,
I will turn a river of peace toward her, with an inundating torrent:
et quasi torrentem inundantem gloriam gentium,
the glory of the Gentiles, from which you will nurse.
You will be carried at the breasts,
and they will caress you upon the knees.
In the manner of one whom a mother caresses,
And you will be consoled in Jerusalem.
and your heart will be glad,
et ossa vestra quasi herba germinabunt:
and your bones will flourish like a plant,
et cognoscetur manus Domini servis ejus,
and the hand of the Lord will be known to his servants,
and he will be angry with his enemies.
Quia ecce Dominus in igne veniet,
For behold, the Lord will arrive with fire,
and his four-horse chariots will be like a whirlwind:
reddere in indignatione furorem suum et increpationem suam in flamma ignis:
to render his wrath with indignation, and his rebuke with flames of fire.
For the Lord will divide with fire,
et in gladio suo ad omnem carnem;
and with his sword among all flesh,
and those slain by the Lord will be many.
et mundos se putabant in hortis post januam intrinsecus,
who thought themselves to be clean in the gardens behind the inner gate,
they will be consumed all at once,
Ego autem opera eorum et cogitationes eorum venio ut congregem,
But I know their works and their thoughts. I am arriving,
so that I may gather them together with all nations and languages.
et venient, et videbunt gloriam meam.
And they will approach, and they will see my glory.
And I will set a sign among them.
et mittam ex eis qui salvati fuerint, ad gentes in mare, in Africam,
And I will send some of those who will have been saved to the Gentiles in the sea,
tendentes sagittam; in Italiam et Græciam,
and to those who draw the bow in Lydia, to Italy and Greece,
ad eos qui non audierunt de me,
to those who have not heard of me,
and to those who have not seen my glory.
And they will announce my glory to the Gentiles.
et adducent omnes fratres vestros de cunctis gentibus donum Domino,
And they will lead all of your brothers from all of the Gentiles as a gift to the Lord,
quomodo si inferant filii Israël munus in vase mundo in domum Domini.
in the same manner that the sons of Israel would carry an offering in a pure vessel into the house of the Lord.
Et assumam ex eis in sacerdotes et Levitas,
And I will take from them to be priests and Levites,
Quia sicut cæli novi et terra nova,
For in like manner as the new heavens and the new earth,
quæ ego facio stare coram me,
which I will cause to stand before me,
sic stabit semen vestrum et nomen vestrum.
so will your offspring and your name stand.
And there will be month after month,
veniet omnis caro ut adoret coram facie mea,
And all flesh will approach, so as to adore before my face,
et videbunt cadavera virorum qui prævaricati sunt in me;
and they will view the carcasses of the men who have transgressed against me.
and their fire will not be extinguished.
et erunt usque ad satietatem visionis omni carni.
And they will be a sight to all flesh even unto revulsion.
